summary: ACTOOS ONE - Wallet Payer/Encaisser Button Flow Testing. All tests PASSED. The fix implemented by main agent correctly inverted the button behavior: PAYER now opens Scanner (to scan someone's QR and pay them), ENCAISSER now opens QR Generator (to show my QR so someone can pay me).
critical_code_review_comments: WalletScreen.jsx lines 268-285: Button logic is now correct - Payer (data-testid='pay-qr-btn') calls setShowScanQR(true) which opens ScanQRCodeSheet (scanner), Encaisser (data-testid='scan-qr-btn') calls setShowPayQR(true) which opens PayQRCodeSheet (QR generator)
WalletQRPayment.jsx: PayQRCodeSheet has title 'Encaisser un paiement' and generates QR for receiving payment, ScanQRCodeSheet has title 'Payer avec QR' and provides scanner interface for paying
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wallet Payer/Encaisser buttons are working correctly. The fix inverted the button handlers so that Payer opens scanner and Encaisser shows QR code. Cookie consent popup needs to be dismissed with 'Accepter' button, location popup with 'Plus tard' button before navigating.

test_1_login.details: Login not required - user session was already active. Wallet loaded successfully with console message: '✅ Wallet chargé'

test_2_wallet_access.details: ACTOOS Pay wallet screen displays correctly via Wallet tab in bottom navigation. Shows balance 0 FCFA, buttons: Recharger, Envoyer, Payer, Encaisser. Tabs: Historique, Sous-comptes, Cartes.

test_3_payer_button.details: PAYER button (data-testid='pay-qr-btn') opens 'Payer avec QR' sheet which shows SCANNER interface with text 'Scannez le QR du bénéficiaire'. This is CORRECT behavior - user scans someone's QR to pay them.

test_4_encaisser_button.details: ENCAISSER button (data-testid='scan-qr-btn') opens 'Encaisser un paiement' sheet which shows QR GENERATOR interface with amount input and 'Générer le QR Code' button. This is CORRECT behavior - user generates their QR so someone can pay them.

test_5_logic_verification.details: Logic is correct: PAYER opens SCANNER (to scan someone's QR and pay them), ENCAISSER shows MY QR (so someone can scan and pay me). The reported bug has been fixed.

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: User reported that 'Encaisser' was opening a scanner instead of showing a QR code
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Main agent inverted the button handlers in WalletScreen.jsx - Payer now calls setShowScanQR(true) and Encaisser calls setShowPayQR(true)
bug_fix_verification.verification_result: FIXED - Both buttons now work as expected
